title: AI Background Remover
description: Remove image backgrounds automatically in seconds.
longDesc: Our advanced background removal tool leverages neural networks to identify and segment foreground elements, producing transparent PNGs with crisp details and smooth edges.

faqs.question: What image formats are supported?
faqs.answer: We support PNG, JPG, and WebP images up to 10MB in size.

articles.title: Why background removal matters
articles.content: Clean cutouts are essential for commercial product photography, web layouts, and corporate profiles.

title: PDF to Word Converter
description: Convert PDF files into editable Word documents online.
longDesc: ToolWala AI PDF to Word Converter extracts text structures, headings, and paragraphs locally to build editable DOCX files.

title: Word to PDF Converter
description: Convert Word documents (.docx) into PDF files locally and securely.
longDesc: ToolWala AI Word to PDF Converter parses paragraphs, formatting, headings, and lists locally on your device to build high-quality PDF documents.

faqs.question: Is it secure to upload my documents?
faqs.answer: Yes, our tools process files entirely client-side. Your documents are never uploaded to any server.

articles.title: Secure Client-Side DOCX to PDF
articles.content: Our parser reads and wraps text elements inside the browser, rendering high-fidelity PDFs instantly.

title: AI PDF Summarizer
description: Summarize large PDF documents locally in your browser. Fast, private, and secure.
longDesc: The AI PDF Summarizer reads the text content of your PDF files locally on your device using browser-native parsers and generates a concise, readable summary. Your document content is never sent to external servers or used for training AI models.

faqs.question: Is my uploaded PDF document private?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our AI PDF Summarizer operates entirely client-side. The text is parsed directly in your browser memory and is never uploaded to any remote database.

faqs.question: What is the maximum file size supported?
faqs.answer: You can process PDF documents up to 50MB in size since all operations run in local memory.

articles.title: How On-Device PDF Summarization Works
articles.content: Our engine extracts the text layer from your document, performs keyword and semantic filtering locally, and formats it into structured highlights.
